title: UMBRAL
content: Today I received a report from a spiritualist here at my work, and even though I don't agree with spiritism at all and think it's a satanic practice, I know that there are creatures manipulating these people, and in this case, some of the 'contacts' they have really happen. This person told me that in one of the contacts, the 'spiritual guide', as he calls himself, said that there are several thresholds that exist and are accessed through dreams, each person has their own threshold, and these same thresholds can be accessed by entities and other people. I know that this guy is not a bad person, but he is very manipulated by these entities, but in the case of this report, I believe he is telling the truth, and if so, it is something very dangerous, because if several entities can really enter them, we would be being attacked in certain mallworlds.
